head: 8f966adc9
method: Re-captured on the current build, not from the engineer's sheets: node _harness/vfx_gallery.mjs at --zoom 31 (the gameplay camera's default distance), world events at --scale 1 (the director's scale), abilities at the default scale. BEFORE is a pinned catalog: the current dist-catalog with content/vfx.json and the 15 items.json vfx refs from 36163c40b (catalog 2026.11.5 as shipped), monsterDeath unbound. AFTER is the current dist-catalog (content/vfx.json matches it; build_vfx --check: 302 defs, 51 tuned, 0 changes). Also re-ran probe_combat_polish ult,hold --ults all (the full 16-ult run). The pinned catalog was removed afterwards. Shots: scratchpad only (v1q_ev_*, v1q_ab_*), not committed.

items.evidence: Recapture at scale 1: the 0.05 s team-light ball is clearly smaller and dimmer (5.5 m x5), and by 0.15-0.4 s the frame is no longer washed blue. At 0.9 s the black ink ruin smoke is now warm-grey smoke. The 0.05 s flash is still a soft blue ball, but it is local.
The 0.4 s and 0.9 s frames now show a warm brown char inside the tick ring, not the near-black hole. The black ink plume over the body at 0.4 s is gone, replaced by sparse warm embers.

The structure_land 0.9 s frame shows faint warm-grey smoke where round 1 had two near-black blobs. Not covered: lib_wick_death (minion death, the most frequent event in a fight) still puts out a near-black ink blob at 0.15-0.4 s, identical before and after. hesmi_ult_windup and hesmi_ult_shadow also still show small near-black puffs.
Before, the dome was a dark blue ball with a bright rim. After, it is an open additive bell, rim only, and the ground shows through. A few dark specks remain near the rim at 0.9 s.

Before, a dim violet ring that was hard to find on the dark plaza. After, a bright rose-pink ring that reads at 31 m at every sample time. It is a flat ring with little motion, so it is legible but plain.

The opaque cream fan mesh is gone from all three. Sunsplinter: a bright ring_thin front runs over a cracked sun-gold fill, and the black wedge ahead of the front (round 2's first try, and 2026.11.5) is gone. The 0.7 s frame is clean. Cone: a blue front ring over a fill. Longshade: the 12 large black outlined blobs became 7 small warm-grey puffs with a lamp-amber arc. It still lays a near-black chevron ink decal; that is on-theme (Longshade is the shadow) and has a cream edge.

The column is softer Dawnglass and two white dial rings step down onto the feet, with an extra ring at 0.4 s. It reads as more than one light column, but the column still dominates at 0.05-0.15 s. A modest gain.
The black ink stain with spikes at 0.4-0.9 s is gone. After: a rune dial and a rim-lit sleeve that leave the ground clean.

The items.json diff against 36163c40b shows the 15 vfx refs moved (only present.vfx fields). In the recapture, lib_item_bell_toll (a cream double ring with toll ticks) and lib_item_glass_ward are distinct from the shared lib_ring_pulse and lib_shield_up. From the engineer's sheet, lib_item_needle_shadow and lib_item_edge_pace are fainter than the generic looks they replace, so they are easy to miss at the gameplay camera.
A warm orange flash, a radial crack star and embers, bound in catalog.client.vfxEvents.monsterDeath. Before, monsters used the minion's tiny black-ink wick death.
Not built. The engineer's reason holds: the sim has no enrage state, and the term is on the protected-names list. Accepted as out of scope for a VFX lane, not as a failure.

items.id: VFX-6 ult re-tune (Hesmi, Lisvel, Nurrow, Vashil)
items.evidence: My probe_combat_polish ult,hold --ults all (fw_W1_combat_polish_vfx_v1q_max2.json) PASSES. Hesmi lost 2, min 0.38 (round 1 0.34). Lisvel lost 1, min 0.41, box 0.184 (round 1: lost 2, 0.23, 0.308): a real gain. Nurrow lost 2, min 0.30 (round 1 0.33). Vashil lost 2, min 0.30, box 0.321 (round 1 0.27 / 0.318). The engineer's 'Nurrow 1 (0.47)' and 'Vashil box 0.209' come from the 4-ult subset run and do not reproduce in the full-roster run. Only Lisvel is clearly better; Hesmi, Nurrow and Vashil stay at the limit.
Re-measured: discMs kemdo 300, rishal 333, tunlan 200 (gate >= 167), the same as claimed and as round 1. PASS.

ardit_ult_windup, hesmi_ult_windup and lib_ult_windup now show a 2.3 m team-blue countdown hour-dial that closes into an arc, plus a signature shaft. It reads at 31 m where round 1's thin ring did not (verify1 had marked this item 'same'). Not measured inside a crowded team fight, only on open ground.
The lib_hit_phys_heavy before and after rows are almost the same at 31 m; the 0.009 distort ring cannot be seen. It costs nothing visible either (tier >= 3, never Low).

problems.what: lib_wick_death (minion death) still makes a near-black ink blob, the same ink_puff class the lane fixed elsewhere
problems.evidence: v1q_ev_cur/before rows lib_wick_death at 0.15 s and 0.4 s: a black outlined blob, identical before and after; minion deaths are the most frequent effect in a fight
problems.fix: Move lib_wick_death's puff to SMOKE2/DUST warm grey, as structure_break was; also the ink puffs in hesmi_ult_windup and hesmi_ult_shadow

problems.what: The VFX-6 improvements claimed for Nurrow (detailLost 1) and Vashil (box white 0.209) do not reproduce in the full --ults all run
problems.evidence: fw_W1_combat_polish_vfx_v1q_max2.json: nurrow lost 2 min 0.30, vashil lost 2 min 0.30 box 0.321; only the 4-ult subset reports m2_r3 and m2r2_b show the gain (a different lineup)
problems.fix: Judge ult tunes on the full --ults all run. The remaining flattening is actors.ts VICTIM_FLASH T4 (units lane); ask that lane to skip the heavy-hit feel on a unit an ult feel already boosts

problems.what: VFX-11 heat ring is invisible at the gameplay camera
problems.evidence: lib_hit_phys_heavy before/after rows at 0.05/0.15 s are the same
problems.fix: Raise the distort strength to about 0.015-0.02 for 0.15 s, or drop the layer

problems.what: Some item-family procs are fainter than the generic looks they replace
problems.evidence: m2_items_monster_ab: lib_item_needle_shadow and lib_item_edge_pace are barely visible at 31 m
problems.fix: Lift their emissive or alpha to about the strength of lib_ring_pulse

budgets: This round adds no texture, render target or geometry shape. The sweeps drop a mesh draw, and round2b changes decal and feel parameters only, so it is neutral on triangles, draws and memory. perf_1080.json (11:28Z, after 0ab209036, which carried the round-2 geometry-affecting defs) gives match peak 449,788 tris, 294 draws, 40 programs: within 500k / 450 / 40. match_memory.json (11:42Z, after 0ab209036): BRIDGE 2426 MB, RIFT 2940 MB (bar 3000 MB, margin 60). The machine was busy (load up to 220) and the run is labelled 'would pass'. Frame timing is owed to the final idle gate. build_vfx --check: 302 defs, 0 changes.
notes: Sensitivity: none. No hoods, faces or horror reads, and the effects carry no figures. Originality: the motifs are VALE's own (hour-dial countdowns, Dawnglass, ink, Gleam, sun-gold cracks) and no League ability or effect is reproduced. Compared with round 1 (verify1 7.5), the lane is clearly better on every round-1 open problem: structure light flood, the black-hole scorch, ink blobs over bodies and ruins, the dark silence ball, the opaque sweep cones, the respawn column, the summon stain, the weak resist shred, the missing item and monster defs, and the unreadable ult wind-ups. The remaining gaps are minor: minion-death ink, invisible VFX-11, and VFX-6 that is only better on Lisvel. Against the LoL gauge, sweeps, status and world events now read at par. Hit feedback and the heavy-hit second beat are still plainer than the gauge, which holds the score near 7.8. Nothing deployed; only this file is committed.
